root_cause_label: Infinite retry loop on failed sklearn import without remediation
one_sentence_failure_summary: After scikit-learn failed to import despite being installed (likely a Python interpreter/pip mismatch), the agent entered an infinite loop repeating the same failing verification command 30 times without ever attempting to reinstall, diagnose the path mismatch, or proceed past the setup phase.
t_err_evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sklearn'; agent notes only 'exit code 1', failing to diagnose the missing module
t_commit_evidence: From step 17 onward every remaining step (17-46) issues the same failing command; the outcome is locked in because no remediation action (reinstall, interpreter-path check, python -m pip) is ever attempted, and all 30 remaining steps are consumed by this loop.
t_surface_evidence: Traceback (most recent call last): ... ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sklearn' [The command completed with exit code 1.]
trigger_explanation: At step 16 the agent observed a clear ModuleNotFoundError for sklearn and received exit code 1, but instead of diagnosing the likely interpreter/pip mismatch or attempting python -m pip install scikit-learn, it re-issued the identical failing command in step 17 and continued doing so for all 30 remaining steps, never changing strategy.
forewarning_evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sklearn' despite step 12 reporting 'Successfully installed ... scikit-learn-1.7.0'
